content: Start an AI chat to ask questions, summarize documents, generate texts and get help with your work — right inside {{sectionName}}.

comment.text: Description text for an interactive product tour step explaining the AI chat feature's capabilities. The {{sectionName}} variable represents the current section name, such as "Files" or "Rooms".

usage.context:

 showFilter &&
 elementStep(
 '[data-testid="quick-ai-chat"]',

 t("FilesTour:TourAiAssistant", { sectionName: t("Common:Files") }),
 callbacks,
 LOG_LABEL,
 6,

 ),
